Nostalgia

A wistful, often bittersweet longing for the past.

  • Emotions
  • Psychology
  • Vocabulary

Context

Nostalgia can gather around people, places, objects, music, games, or an earlier stage of life. The feeling combines affection for what is remembered with awareness that time has passed.

In my writing about liminal spaces, nostalgia helps explain why an empty school, an old mall, or a familiar game soundtrack can feel emotionally charged. Anemoia names a related longing for a time someone never personally experienced.

Examples

  • A song from a childhood Pokémon game can evoke nostalgia for the time and place where someone first played it.

  • Nostalgia in the APA Dictionary of Psychology
